rules.death_loot: Entire bag and every worn slot, including backpack. Atomic capacity check; pending kits survive recovery; no phantom pack or repeated death drop. Airborne loot projects to collision ground and avoids walls.
rules.armour: 50 durability per piece, encoded in the existing 0..100 reserve. Actual received combat damage including shield absorption splits evenly across intact worn pieces. Each grants 1/4 family modifiers. Broken pieces are removed. Matching four-piece sets suspend wear without repairing it.
rules.storm: Eligible regions get equal odds before seeded site selection. Plants and chests extend across the map. Initial radius 1000 m, anchors within 900 m, complete closure at 602 s; nested circles and longer early travel phases.
rules.feedback: Red edge pulse lasts 0.65 s after a hit, keeps aiming centre clear, remains above bag/loot panels and cancels during recovery.
